description.value: Kozak is a Ukrainian restaurant and cafe in Langley serving homemade Ukrainian food. It presents itself as an authentic destination for traditional Ukrainian cuisine in the Fraser Valley. Online ordering is available, suggesting the kitchen can accommodate both dine-in and takeout customers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website (kozakeatery.ca) is live and its page titles confirm 'Authentic Ukrainian Restaurant and Cafe | Kozak Homemade Ukrainian Food,' corroborating the OSM record. However, virtually all fetched page content is cookie-consent boilerplate; no readable body text survives to confirm amenities, contact details, or facilities beyond what OSM provides. The existence of a subpage titled 'Order Online' (/s/order) is the sole website-derived amenity signal, indicating takeout/online ordering is available.
concerns: Website content is almost entirely cookie-consent boilerplate; no readable business text was extracted, so amenities and contact details could not be verified from the site.

OSM contact:facebook tag points to 'https://www.facebook.com/solodko.ca/' — 'Solodko' differs from the business name 'Kozak' and may be a related brand, former identity, or data error worth verifying.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating Ukrainian restaurant with an active website and online ordering. Clearly publicly accessible and useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal.

wow_evidence: Authentic Ukrainian Restaurant and Cafe | Kozak Homemade Ukrainian Food
